title: Waiver of Seller’s Stamp Duty for Collective Sale if Seller Does Not Agree to Sale
what_it_is: Waiver of Seller’s Stamp Duty for Collective Sale if Seller Does Not Agree to Sale

sections.label: SSD in collective sales
sections.summary: SSD applies if a collective sale occurs within the holding period, even for non-consenting minority owners, who may object to the Strata Titles Board.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: SSD is applicable so long as the property is sold within the holding period.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: In a collective sale of private residential properties, the collective sale committee can enter into a sale and purchase agreement on behalf of all owners, if the requisite statutory majority consent has been obtained.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: If the sale occurs within the holding period, SSD is applied, regardless of whether an individual owner consented to or opposed the sale.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: In particular, non-consenting minority owners to a collective sale can file objections to the Strata Titles Board against the sale and the Board will then consider the objections raised before deciding on the outcome of the application of the collective sale.
